name: Revenue
definition: Revenue as reported (IFRS 15). Company-specific top-line definitions are documented on the company sheet.

name: Gross profit
definition: Revenue less cost of sales, as reported.

name: Operating income
definition: Operating profit as reported (before finance costs, zakat and tax).

name: EBITDA (company-reported)
definition: As disclosed by the company with its own definition; shown for reference only.

name: Net profit attributable to shareholders
definition: Net income attributable to equity holders of the parent, after zakat and tax.

name: Underlying net profit attributable
definition: NI_ATTR less material one-offs identified in the Adjustments register (C).

name: Capital expenditure
definition: Purchases of property, plant & equipment and intangibles (cash-flow statement).

name: Net debt
definition: Borrowings incl. lease liabilities less cash and short-term deposits, as reported or calculated (C).

name: Total operating income
definition: As reported; components checked to sum.

name: Net special commission / financing income
definition: Special commission income less expense; Islamic banks' 'net income from financing and investments' mapped here and flagged.

name: Other operating income
definition: TOI less NSCI less fees (FX, trading, investment, dividend, other) (C).

name: Operating expenses before impairment
definition: Total operating expenses excluding ECL and other impairment charges (C where filing includes impairments).

name: Impairment charges (net)
definition: Net ECL and other impairment charges, total.

name: Tier 1 sukuk
definition: Period-end carrying amount of Additional Tier 1 sukuk classified in equity.

name: Tier 1 sukuk distributions
definition: Distributions on Tier 1 sukuk charged to equity in the period.

name: Return on ordinary equity (calculated)
definition: (NI_ATTR - T1_COST) / average (EQ_ATTR - T1_SUKUK); YTD annualised x12/months.

name: ROE (company definition)
definition: As disclosed by the bank; definitions differ; reference only.

name: NSCI margin on average assets (proxy)
definition: NSCI / average total assets; YTD annualised.

name: Rig fleet
definition: Owned/operated rigs at period end, as disclosed.

name: Fleet utilisation
definition: As disclosed; definition noted per company.
